title: Brachiate
summary: BRACH'IATE, adjective [See Brachial.] In botany, having branches in pairs, decussated, all nearly horizontal, and each pair at right angles with the next.

inlines.v: BRACH'IATE, adjective [See Brachial.] In botany, having branches in pairs, decussated, all nearly horizontal, and each pair at right angles with the next.
